title: Kuang Wang 2
description:

(Source: WeTV)

title: Doupo Cangqiong Movie: Shuang Di Zhi Zhan
description:
Above Canaan Academy, the Soul Clan and the Heavenly Mansion Alliance clashed over the legendary Tuoshe Ancient Emperor. The Soul Emperor used the ancient jade to open his cave, beginning the struggle for the opportunity to become an Emperor.

With the help of the Void Devouring Flame, the Soul Emperor successfully obtained a preliminary Emperor-grade pill, while Xiao Yan's fate remained unknown during the struggle. The Soul Emperor successfully advanced to Dou Di and led the Soul Clan army to attack the Heavenly Mansion Alliance. Just when everyone was in despair, the Xiao Clan's bloodline stirred.

Gu Yuan realized that Xiao Yan might be breaking through to Dou Di, which became everyone's last hope. Everyone fought to the death to buy time for Xiao Yan to become an Emperor, and Xiao Yan lived up to their expectations, descending like a god, and thus the battle between the two Emperors is about to begin.

(Source: Tencent, translated, edited)
